dogecoin.text:
It’s amazing how quick the media dismisses an outlier like $AMC to defend the sanctity of the all mighty, fair & important equity market, but how quick they all use a similar singular outlier like $DOGE to dismiss the entire digital assets market. 

Untether preconceived notions

Meanwhile, 90% of the industry coverage is still predicated on guessing when $BTC or $DOGE will move +/- 5%. 

For those who aren't trying to get on CNBC, it's way more profitable to just buy the token's of good, fast growing companies and projects.
